Authorised as a crypto-asset service provider or issuer of asset-referenced tokens under MiCA.
Authorised as a crowdfunding service provider, critical benchmark administrator, or securitisation repository.

term_types.name: Enterprise size class
term_types.question: Is the enterprise a microenterprise, small enterprise, or medium-sized enterprise by staff and turnover or balance-sheet thresholds?
term_types.description: Classifies enterprises by employee count and turnover or balance-sheet thresholds, relevant to proportionate regulatory treatment.

values.definition: Fewer than 10 staff with turnover or balance sheet up to EUR 2 million.
10 to 49 staff with turnover or balance sheet up to EUR 10 million.
Fewer than 250 staff with turnover up to EUR 50 million or balance sheet up to EUR 43 million.

term_types.name: Small occupational pension institution status
term_types.question: Does the occupational pension institution have fewer than 100 members?
term_types.description: Identifies small occupational pension institutions by member count, which affects their regulatory treatment.

values.definition: Occupational pension institution with fewer than 100 members.
Occupational pension institution with 100 or more members.

term_types.name: Critical ICT third-party provider status
term_types.question: Has the ICT third-party provider been designated as critical?
term_types.description: Determines whether an ICT third-party provider is designated critical under the EU regime.

values.definition: Designated as a critical ICT third-party service provider under Article 31.
Not designated as a critical ICT third-party service provider.

term_types.name: ICT provider establishment location
term_types.question: Where is the ICT third-party provider legally established?
term_types.description: Classifies ICT providers by whether they are established inside or outside the EU.

values.definition: Legally established within the European Union.
Legally established outside the European Union.

term_types.name: ICT provider group relationship
term_types.question: Is the ICT provider within the same group as the financial entity?
term_types.description: Distinguishes intra-group ICT providers from external third-party providers.

values.definition: Belongs to the same group as the financial entity.
Not part of the financial entity's group.

term_types.name: Critical or important function status
term_types.question: Would disruption to the function materially impair performance, continuity or compliance?
term_types.description: Classifies ICT services and functions by whether disruption would materially impair financial performance, continuity, or regulatory compliance.

values.definition: Disruption would materially impair financial performance, service continuity, or regulatory compliance.
Disruption would not materially impair these interests.

term_types.name: ICT incident severity
term_types.question: Does the ICT-related incident have an adverse impact on critical functions or payment services?
term_types.description: Classifies ICT-related and payment-related incidents as major or non-major by adverse impact.

values.definition: Has an adverse impact on critical functions or payment services.
Does not meet the adverse impact threshold.

term_types.name: ICT incident type
term_types.question: Is the incident ICT-related or payment-related?
term_types.description: Separates ICT-related incidents from payment-related incidents.

values.definition: Incident related to information and communication technology systems.
Incident related to payment services.

term_types.name: Cyber threat significance
term_types.question: Is the cyber threat significant or ordinary?
term_types.description: Classifies cyber threats by their significance relative to ordinary threats.

values.definition: Threat judged significant under DORA classification criteria.
Threat not judged significant.

term_types.name: Legacy ICT system status
term_types.question: Is the ICT system end-of-life, unsupported, or still in use?
term_types.description: Classifies legacy ICT systems by their support lifecycle state.

values.definition: Vendor support has ended for the system.
System is no longer supported for updates or fixes.
System remains operational despite ageing.

term_types.name: Operational risk category
term_types.question: Which operational risk category does the event or weakness fall into?
term_types.description: Classifies operational risks facing investors and consumers by their source, such as system failure, human error, governance, or code flaws.

values.definition: Failure of the underlying technical system.
Mistakes by people operating or using the system.
Failure in decision-making or oversight of the network or provider.
Unauthorised access or disclosure of data.
Transactions that cannot be reversed once recorded.
Problems arising when systems fail to work together.
Coding flaws in smart contracts.

term_types.name: Prominent public function status
term_types.question: Does the person hold a prominent public function such as a politically exposed person role?
term_types.description: Determines whether a person holds a prominent public function, subject to Member State threshold adjustments.

values.definition: Holds a prominent public function within the defined scope.
Does not hold a prominent public function.

term_types.name: Shell institution status
term_types.question: Does the institution have physical presence, management, or regulatory affiliation in a jurisdiction?
term_types.description: Identifies shell institutions lacking physical presence, management, or regulatory affiliation.

values.definition: Lacks physical presence, management or regulatory affiliation.
Has physical presence, management or regulatory affiliation.

term_types.name: Trust arrangement category
term_types.question: Is the trust an express trust, an object of a power, a default taker, or another legal arrangement?
term_types.description: Distinguishes express trusts, objects of a power, default takers, and other legal arrangements.

values.definition: Trust deliberately created by settlor.
Person who may benefit under a power of appointment.
Person who takes where no other beneficiary is determined.
Legal arrangement not falling within the above categories.

term_types.name: Sanctions legal source
term_types.question: What is the legal source of the targeted financial sanctions, UN or EU?
term_types.description: Distinguishes targeted financial sanctions by their legal source, such as UN resolutions or EU measures.

values.definition: Sanctions imposed under UN Security Council resolutions, including proliferation financing.
Targeted financial sanctions imposed under EU measures.

term_types.name: Applicable rule tradition
term_types.question: Under which regulatory tradition is the asset or activity classified?
term_types.description: Identifies which legal test or framework is applied to classify an asset or activity.

values.definition: U.S. investment contract test for securities.
EU MiFID II financial instrument classification.
EU alternative investment fund or asset-referenced token test.
MiCAR classification test for stablecoins.

term_types.name: Home jurisdiction for regulated actor
term_types.question: Which Member State or jurisdiction serves as the home regulator for the actor, based on registered office, branch, or authorisation?
term_types.description: Identifies the home jurisdiction that supervises an actor, determined by registered office, branch presence, or authorising state.

values.definition: Home is the state of the registered office, as for ART issuers and CASPs.
Home is the state that authorised the entity, as for EMT issuers.
Home is the branch state or offer state for offerors or third-country entities.
